verdict.rationale: Ollama's own marketing says prompts are "never tracked or trained on" and that "nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine." That implies a no-tracking posture for local use, which makes opting out largely moot there. However, these are brief homepage claims, not a documented telemetry control. missing for 10: a documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting, clarity on whether app or cloud usage metrics are collected, in-depth privacy docs, and independent or hands-on verification that no data leaves the machine.
